notes: This is a French public licence (Parcoursup fiche). The 178 EUR/year tuition is the national public rate listed on the programme's own page and a differentiated fee (2 902 EUR) is stated by Campus France Maroc for extra-community students in a Licence; the page itself does not state a non-EU-specific amount, so the differentiated rate is left out and the stated rate is kept for auditing. Campus France Maroc pages describe requirements (TCF/DELF B2 certification obligatory for the Etudes en France application, except exemptions; applicants to 100% English programmes other than L1 may be exempt, but L1 university applicants are not exempt) — these are general Campus France procedure pages, not this programme's page, and are not stated for this licence; the programme page itself only states 'Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2'. No documents list is given on the programme page. No application channel output per task instruction (Etudes en France/DAP applies for a foreign-diploma applicant).
